limits: Synthetic noninferior fixture pairs (OD-4); candidate texts must be in the run store named by --run-id (one run per call).
outcome: passed: after two committed promotions, a rollback preview names the active and restored candidate digests and the sealed journal reason, writes nothing and carries requiredDecision human-apply and executionAuthorization false; the apply with its digest re-checks the previewed registry and file digests, writes the restored text read from the run store, then the registry (journal rolled-back); the active candidate equals the file digest. A release build check over the exported registry passes. The CLI lightning promote --rollback previews and applies with the digest. Negative controls: rollback with no previous candidate (no-previous), without a registry (no-active-profile), stale preview after a file edit, a different reason than previewed, and a change between the check and the write (preview-stale), and a failed registry save that restores the file and keeps the active candidate (apply-failed).
